intent: Photoreal beauty pass over a dimensionally-correct clay control render (HYBRID render direction of record, docs/DECISIONS-render-assets.md).
engine_contract: Single-track image-edit instruction + one control image. Model choice/fallback lives in the dispatch script (pipeline/scripts/hybrid_render.py), never here.
template: Transform this 3D clay render of a {room_type} into a photorealistic interior photograph. CRITICAL: keep the exact room geometry, camera angle, wall/window/door positions, and the position, size and proportions of every furniture piece and built-in unchanged — the layout is dimensionally accurate and must not move or be redrawn. Replace the flat clay materials with: {material_story}. Lighting: {lighting_story}. Style direction: {style_brief}. Render as a professional interior-photography shot: realistic fabric weave, true wood grain, soft contact shadows, subtle glass and metal reflections, physically plausible exposure. No people, no text, no watermarks, no borders.

slots.material_story: comma prose of the target materials

defaults.material_story: warm walnut wood flooring and millwork, boucle and linen upholstery, matte off-white walls, brushed-metal accents
defaults.lighting_story: soft warm cove lighting plus diffuse daylight from the window side, gentle falloff, no blown highlights
defaults.style_brief: contemporary Thai residential, calm and livable, quiet luxury

provenance: Generalized 2026-07-02 from the ad-hoc CLI instruction proven on living_demo: clay control 1/5 NOT_CLIENT_READY -> hybrid 4/5 REWORK (photoreal/proportion/furniture 5/5). Exact original CLI text was not preserved — this registry exists so that never happens again.
notes: Client work must run on the PAID Gemini tier (free tier = no commercial rights).
Output is DRAFT until it passes critique.py + human QA.
Layout-preservation clause is load-bearing — do not weaken it in future versions.
